paragraphs.text: Hammerheim is a mountain fortress that stands as a crossroads in the Domains of Dominaria , making whoever controls Hammerheim the very person who controls the flow of trade to Cape Tempest .

It is located in North Aerona , between the Smoke Mountains and the Sea of Whales . Hammerheim is the birthplace of Bartel Runeaxe . The Hammerheim Order was a group of pyromancers from Hammerheim during the Brothers' War .
